strategy: Maintain Clash's Punishment buff every 5 seconds while spamming Blessed Shield into enemy packs. Rely on Thorns scaling rather than weapon damage, use Rally frequently for speed and sustain, and transition to endgame content at level 70 after unlocking Paragon Boards.
